Name: Scarecrow in traditional Asian costumes
Author: NgocNgoc
Description:
[size=2][i](Since English is not my native language I will have to use google translate so if there is any mistake please let me know so I can correct it.)
[/i][/size]                                                                 --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
[b]                                                                                                    [size=4]Introduce mods:[/size][/b]

This mod allows you to replace (CP) or craft (JA) scarecrows wearing some traditional Asian costumes. . I will probably add more traditional costumes from many countries in the future if I have time.

                                                                  -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
                                                                                                              [size=4][b]Installation:[/b]
[/size]
[list=1]
[*]Download the required mods and this mod to anywhere you'd like. (You need ContentPatcher for CP version, JsonAssets for JA version, and SMAPI for both to work. See SMAPI instruction.)
[*] Unzip the required mods and this mod then move them to Stardew Valley \Mod folder.
[*]Run the game through SMAPI.
[/list][color=#f1f1f1]
[/color]                                                                  --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------                                                                                                                                                                                                                 [color=#f1f1f1][size=4][b]Note:[/b][/size][/color][color=#f1f1f1]
[/color][color=#f1f1f1][size=4][b]
[/b][/size][/color][color=#f1f1f1][left][size=1]The CP version is not compatible with any other mod that replaces the default scarecrows, but you can config it to your liking if you have the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Config Menu[/url]﻿﻿. Download the JA version if you want to keep other scarecrow mods. You can buy the recipe from Pierre with 2000g and the crafting recipe is the same as the scarecrow.
[/size][/left][/color]
                                                                  --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
